title: Stein Variational Gradient Descent dynamics for highly concentrated kernels
summary: Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) is a widely used in practice algorithm for scalable sampling with deterministic particle updates. We study its behavior in the singular limit where the kernel bandwidth tends to zero. In this regime, we show that the nonlocal SVGD dynamics converge to a local evolution equation that can be formally interpreted as a Wasserstein gradient flow with quadratic mobility.
